high_level_description: This black-and-white image depicts a celestial body, likely a comet or an asteroid, set against the backdrop of space. The object is elongated and irregularly shaped, with a rough, textured surface that suggests it could be a rocky or icy body. A bright, glowing tail extends from one end of the object, indicating the presence of a coma or a tail of gas and dust being ejected due to solar radiation, which is characteristic of comets. The background is a deep black, speckled with numerous small white dots representing distant stars, emphasizing the vastness and emptiness of space.
